dummy_spin.angle_of_frame_deg: k * 22.5 (0 = arm pointing east/right, increasing CLOCKWISE on screen, y down); the two arms are opposite, so the picture repeats every 180 deg (frames k and k+8 differ only in which tip is in front)
dummy_spin.hit_test: ground plane: two segments from the foot anchor at angle a and a+180 deg, length 40 px, half-width 4 px, against the player's foot point/box. The dark ground shadow drawn in every frame is exactly this area (it shows the player where it hurts).
dummy_spin.note: frames are pre-rendered (crisp pixels, correct arm-behind/in-front order) - pick the frame from the current angle instead of rotating a texture. Soft shadow alpha < 255.

plum_pole.note: draw the frame with its top-left at the pole's position; contains a soft ground shadow / glow (alpha < 255). idle = not yet lit, lit_* = the current target (pulse), done = already stepped.

step_trigger.note: player foot point inside this circle = standing on the pole

suggested_layout.note: suggestion only (route is a code decision). Yard dirt area = tiles x 20..42, y 25..34; existing map objects to avoid: stakes (21..23, 30..32), dummies (40,29) (41,31), stone weights (38,33) (39,33), racks/drums on row 24. Every pole is >= 2 tiles from a dummy foot, the sweep radius is 1.25 tiles, so poles are safe spots and the paths between them cross the sweeps.
